title: The Complete Map of Dimensional Metrology (0.1 nm to 100 m)
subtitle: Where Metrology Maven's 1.0 core stops, which post-1.0 tracks enter core (MSA, surface texture, calibration labs), and which modalities live in ECO.SDK plugins (D-054).

sections.heading: Why scope discipline matters across 12 orders of magnitude
paragraphs: Dimensional metrology spans atomic-scale semiconductor and optical interferometry (0.1 nm) to shipyard and accelerator geodesy (100 m). Trying to cram every physical sensor modality, multi-gigabyte CT voxel volume, and proprietary controller SDK into a single 1.0 monolith would break the core's pure-Rust CPU-only f64 kernel (C1/C2) and QIF-native simplicity.

Decision D-054 draws an explicit three-tier boundary: (1) ship the four macro-coordinate apps first (Report, Inspect, Probe, Network); (2) expand core post-1.0 with three architectures-aligned tracks—MSA/non-normal SPC (P3), Surface Texture & Precision Form (SURF, P3), and Calibration-Lab Verification (CAL, P4); and (3) keep CT, 2D Vision, On-Machine CNC Probing, Nano/Semi/Optics, and Adjacent Dimensional Engineering behind ECO.SDK plugins or companion projects.
